stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The drummer keeps a steady beat.
items.sentenceZh: 鼓手保持着稳定的节拍。
items.scene: Exactly one adult drummer strikes a floor drum in a steady alternating motion while a mechanical metronome swings beside the instrument. Subtle repeated motion arcs around the drumsticks visually reinforce the regular beat without symbols or notation.
items.altText: 一名鼓手交替敲击落地鼓，旁边的节拍器规律摆动。

items.sentenceEn: The referee intervenes before the argument becomes violence.
items.sentenceZh: 裁判在争执演变成暴力之前介入。
items.scene: On a community sports field, one adult referee calmly steps between two angry adult players who have stopped at a safe distance. The referee holds both open palms outward; teammates guide each player away. No one is struck, injured or armed.
items.altText: 裁判张开双手站在两名争执球员之间，队友将双方安全带开。

items.sentenceEn: The total includes all the fruit from three baskets.
items.sentenceZh: 总数包括三个篮子里的全部水果。
items.scene: Exactly three small fruit baskets sit empty in a row before one large central crate that now contains every apple, pear and orange from them. The simple still life clearly shows three separate source groups already combined into one total, with no other containers.
items.altText: 三个小篮子已经倒空，所有水果集中到中央一个大箱中。

items.meaningZh: 走向；有某种的倾向；易于；照顾；注意
items.sentenceEn: They tend the young plants every morning.
items.sentenceZh: 他们每天早晨照料幼苗。
items.scene: Two adult gardeners carefully tend rows of young greenhouse plants: one waters the soil at the roots while the other supports a fragile stem and removes one dry leaf. The plants are healthy and the caring actions are unmistakable.
items.altText: 两名园丁为温室幼苗浇水、扶正茎秆并摘除枯叶。

items.sentenceEn: The new oven is an investment in the bakery.
items.sentenceZh: 这台新烤箱是对面包店的一项投资。
items.scene: Two adult bakery owners install one sturdy new commercial oven while an older smaller oven sits retired nearby. Fresh trays of bread and increased shelf space show how buying useful equipment supports the bakery's future work, without money symbols.
items.altText: 两位面包店经营者安装新烤箱，旁边旧小烤箱已停用，货架上摆着更多面包。

items.sentenceEn: The group has a discussion around the table.
items.sentenceZh: 小组围桌展开讨论。
items.scene: Five diverse adults sit around one round table in active discussion. One person speaks with an open-hand gesture, two listen attentively, one asks a question and another arranges plain idea cards with no writing. Eye contact connects the whole group.
items.altText: 五名成年人围坐圆桌，一人发言，其他人倾听、提问并整理空白卡片。

items.meaningZh: 手指；指状物；(手套的)手指部分；指针
items.sentenceEn: She smooths the clay with one finger.
items.sentenceZh: 她用一根手指抚平陶土。
items.scene: A close view of an adult potter's complete hand shows exactly one extended index finger gently smoothing a visible ridge on a spinning clay bowl while the other fingers curl safely back. Her focused face remains readable in the background.
items.altText: 陶艺师伸出一根食指抚平旋转陶碗上的凸纹，其他手指自然收起。

items.meaningZh: 花园；果园；菜园；栽培花木
items.sentenceEn: The garden is filled with flowers and herbs.
items.sentenceZh: 花园里种满了花卉和香草。
items.scene: A clearly bounded courtyard garden contains curved planting beds full of varied flowers and culinary herbs, a narrow stone path, small pond and mature shade tree. One adult gardener prunes lavender near a potting bench.
items.altText: 有围墙的庭院花园里分布着花卉、香草、石径、小池塘和树木。

items.meaningZh: 注意；布告；通知；预告；短评
items.sentenceEn: She notices a tiny nest hidden among the branches.
items.sentenceZh: 她注意到树枝间藏着一个小鸟巢。
items.scene: An adult walking in a leafy park suddenly turns her eyes toward a tiny bird nest partly hidden among nearby branches. Her raised finger and alert expression direct attention to the nest while a companion has not yet seen it.
items.altText: 一名成年人停步抬手指向枝叶间的微小鸟巢，同行者尚未发现。

items.sentenceEn: His shell collection fills the display case.
items.sentenceZh: 他的贝壳收藏摆满了展示柜。
items.scene: One adult collector carefully adds a new shell to a glass-front cabinet already holding many distinct seashells arranged by shape and color on small unlabeled shelves. The related objects clearly form a deliberate collection.
items.altText: 收藏者把新贝壳放入展示柜，柜内许多不同贝壳按形状和颜色整齐陈列。

items.sentenceEn: The modern train is quiet and efficient.
items.sentenceZh: 这列现代火车安静而高效。
items.scene: A sleek contemporary electric train arrives at a clean glass-and-steel station with level boarding, wide doors and streamlined form. An older stationary steam locomotive is visible only as a small preserved exhibit in the background, creating restrained historical contrast.
items.altText: 流线型电力列车驶入玻璃钢结构车站，远处陈列着一台旧蒸汽机车。

items.meaningZh: 工作；任务；作业；困难的工作
items.sentenceEn: Their task is to repair the broken bicycle.
items.sentenceZh: 他们的任务是修好这辆损坏的自行车。
items.scene: Two adult volunteers focus on one clearly broken bicycle at a repair stand. One replaces the loose chain while the other aligns the detached front wheel; organized tools and their coordinated attention define one shared task.
items.altText: 两名志愿者围绕同一辆坏自行车协作装链条、校准前轮。

items.sentenceEn: Each partner holds one side of the tent.
items.sentenceZh: 每位搭档各扶住帐篷的一侧。
items.scene: Exactly two adult hiking partners assemble one small tent together. Each holds one end of the same flexible pole and watches the other to coordinate the bend over the tent fabric, showing equal cooperation and mutual dependence.
items.altText: 两名徒步搭档各握帐篷杆一端，相互配合把杆弯到帐篷上方。

items.meaningZh: 肯定的；积极的；有把握的
items.sentenceEn: The team gives a positive response to her idea.
items.sentenceZh: 团队对她的想法作出了肯定回应。
items.scene: An adult designer presents a small physical model to three adult teammates. They respond positively with warm smiles, clear nods, one thumbs-up and one welcoming handshake, while the presenter relaxes with visible relief.
items.altText: 设计师展示模型，三名队友微笑点头、竖起拇指并与她握手表示肯定。

items.meaningZh: 市民的；公民的；有礼貌的
items.sentenceEn: They remain civil during the disagreement.
items.sentenceZh: 他们在意见不合时仍保持礼貌。
items.scene: Two adults with different views sit across a small table and speak calmly in turn. Their open hands, relaxed posture and attentive eye contact remain respectful despite contrasting model pieces placed between them; a neutral facilitator listens nearby.
items.altText: 两名意见不同的成年人隔桌平静交谈，姿态开放并相互倾听。

items.sentenceEn: They prepare dinner together in the kitchen.
items.sentenceZh: 他们一起在厨房准备晚餐。
items.scene: A well-organized home kitchen clearly includes a stove, oven, sink, refrigerator, counters and hanging utensils. Two adults safely prepare vegetables and stir a covered pot together, making the room's cooking function unmistakable.
items.altText: 配有炉灶、烤箱、水槽、冰箱和操作台的厨房里，两名成年人一起做饭。

items.sentenceEn: The consumer compares two products before buying.
items.sentenceZh: 消费者在购买前比较两件商品。
items.scene: One adult shopper stands at a market shelf comparing exactly two plain reusable kettles, holding one in each hand and inspecting their material and handle. A shopping basket rests by her feet, while a cashier waits in the distance.
items.altText: 一名消费者双手各拿一个无品牌水壶，购买前比较材质和把手。

items.sentenceEn: The director prepares a wide shot of the dancers.
items.sentenceZh: 导演准备拍摄舞者的全景镜头。
items.scene: On a safe film set, an adult director looks through a professional cinema camera mounted on a tripod, framing three adult dancers performing across a studio floor. A plain empty monitor shows the wide composition as abstract silhouettes only.
items.altText: 导演通过三脚架电影摄影机取景，准备拍摄三名舞者的宽幅镜头。

items.sentenceEn: They divide the monthly budget among four needs.
items.sentenceZh: 他们把每月预算分配给四项需求。
items.scene: Two adults at a home table divide a fixed pile of plain coins into exactly four clear containers marked only with simple picture icons: a house, vegetables, a bus and a savings jar. The original central pile becomes four planned portions.
items.altText: 两名成年人把一堆硬币分到房屋、食物、交通和储蓄四个图标容器中。

items.meaningZh: 希望；愿望；祝愿；命令；请求
items.sentenceEn: She makes a wish before blowing the dandelion.
items.sentenceZh: 她吹蒲公英之前许下一个愿望。
items.scene: One adult in a meadow gently holds a round dandelion seed head near her face, closes her eyes for a thoughtful pause and then begins a soft breath that releases the first few seeds. Her expression conveys a private hopeful wish.
items.altText: 草地上的成年人闭眼捧着蒲公英许愿，轻吹后几粒种子开始飘散。
